answer: Make registration open a timelock puzzle: the key that activates an identity is encrypted so it can only be opened after a fixed amount of sequential computation, like an ember that must burn down to ash before the next log catches. No spiral of parallel machines helps, because each step depends on the last, and the ridge of the puzzle can only be crossed in order. A farm must pay the full waiting time for every fake, one after another, while honest agents pay it once.
